detailed_description: The JSON to Rust converter transforms JSON data structures into idiomatic Rust structs with Serde serialization support. This tool parses JSON input through a recursive descent parser to construct an abstract syntax tree (AST), analyzing field types including primitive values, arrays, and nested objects. It employs type inference algorithms to determine appropriate Rust types - distinguishing between i32/u64 for numbers, handling special cases like UUID strings, and preserving nullability. The generated code incorporates Serde's derive macros with #[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)] and implements the Deserialize trait for seamless integration with Rust's ecosystem. Users benefit from automated schema generation when building REST API clients, processing configuration files, or modeling database responses. The converter handles edge cases like special characters in keys through Serde's #[serde(rename)] attributes and maintains type consistency across complex hierarchies. It supports Rust editions 2018 and 2021, generating struct definitions with appropriate visibility modifiers and implementing From traits for enum variants derived from JSON arrays. The output includes module-ready code with proper use statements and documentation comments derived from JSON structure metadata.
usage_steps: Paste JSON payload into the input text area or load from file using the 'Import JSON' button
Click 'Validate JSON' to check syntax and confirm structural integrity
Enter root struct name in the 'Struct Name' field (default: 'Root')
Adjust visibility settings via dropdown (options: pub, pub(crate), private)
Configure Serde attributes in the options panel (rename policy, tag/content fields, skip serialization)
Click 'Generate Structs' to produce Rust code with nested type definitions and copy results via the clipboard icon
usage_examples: Converting REST API response JSON into typed structs for a Rust web application consuming external services
Transforming MongoDB document dumps into schema definitions for Rust-based data processing pipelines
Generating configuration struct templates from sample JSON configs for CLI applications
Creating test fixtures by converting sample JSON payloads into compile-time verified Rust types
